notes: New in 1.0.6: clone auto-update now REALLY works - automatic, as ordered. Why it never worked before (root cause, proven from the engine's own code): the 1.0.3 updater ran in ClonesActivity.onCreate, BEFORE the engine service is up, so the package-manager proxy answered 'not installed' / empty list for every clone and the check silently skipped them - and the 1-hour throttle was already consumed, so it never retried. The check now runs only when the engine says it is ready (its own service-available signal, plus a readiness wait), the throttle is stamped only after a real check ran, a claimed update only counts when the re-read version proves it (a stale version is logged STILL STALE, never toasted), and a new receiver fires the moment the real Muse app updates on the Play Store so clones follow immediately, not only on next launch. Includes 1.0.5 (Meta Account page / ERR_CACHE_MISS fix: permission queries answered with the host identity) and 1.0.4 (toast when clones update; every check logged). Installs in place - clones and sign-ins are preserved.
